Corollary
[The cigar is not a finite time singularity model] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0404 ↗ cor:chow-ii-appd-obtaining-singularity-models 1. appD:D.48\group Singularity Models

The cigar soliton, and its product with any flat Ricci flow such as the line, cannot arise as a finite-time singularity model of a Ricci flow on a closed manifold.
